questions.question: At which ground did Alysia Rudolph record their career-best innings (41, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at City Oval, against Dolphins on 2016/01/17.

questions.question: At Khaya Majola Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (T20)?
Which player is the only one in this database's history to score 200+ runs AND take 3+ wickets in the same match?
questions.explanation: Susan Benade is the sole member of the 200-run/3-wicket club, achieving it in a single match against Kei on 10 February 2018 (212 runs, 3 for 26).

questions.question: At which ground did Limpopo Lillies record their 'Highest Total' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Bloemfontein Oval — highest total of 136, against Knights on 2025/11/02.

questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Kei or Iinyathi?
Trisha Chetty set a database record (combined T20 + List A) with a value of 113. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Wicketkeeping Dismissals', held by Trisha Chetty.
